top_categories.workout_context: Toppling Goliath Gravel Grinder's Driftless Area gravel roads, Repeated rolling hills forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 62 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Toppling Goliath Gravel Grinder's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
56ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Toppling Goliath Gravel Grinder, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on punchy Driftless gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Toppling Goliath Gravel Grinder. Train it until it feels boring.
62 miles on punchy Driftless gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Toppling Goliath Gravel Grinder, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Varied gradients on punchy Driftless gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on punchy Driftless gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,500ft of climbing on punchy Driftless gravel does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Toppling Goliath Gravel Grinder’s 62 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Toppling Goliath Gravel Grinder requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on punchy driftless gravel to build confidence. Expect: driftless area gravel roads, repeated rolling hills, rural iowa roads.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 62 miles of punchy driftless gravel in Decorah, Iowa.
